```{r}
#| label: inject-demo-data
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
if (demo_ready) {
  # On fusionne population, densité, chômage par commune.
  # Croissance annuelle moyenne 2017 -> 2021 (RP), en %/an : (P21/P17)^(1/4) - 1.
  growth_df <- arrow::read_parquet(pop_path_alt) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(code_commune)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(code_commune) |>
    dplyr::slice_max(pop_latest, n = 1L, with_ties = FALSE, na_rm = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::transmute(code_commune, p21 = pop_2021,
                     g = ifelse(is.finite(pop_2017) & is.finite(pop_2021) & pop_2017 > 0 & pop_2021 > 0,
                                ((pop_2021 / pop_2017)^(1 / 4) - 1) * 100, NA_real_))
  demo_for_js <- pop_data |>
    dplyr::left_join(growth_df, by = "code_commune") |>
    dplyr::left_join(densite_data |>
                       dplyr::select(code_commune, densite_insee),
                     by = "code_commune") |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      if (exists("defm_ready") && defm_ready) {
        defm_data |> dplyr::select(code_commune, defm_abc)
      } else {
        tibble::tibble(code_commune = character(0), defm_abc = integer(0))
      },
      by = "code_commune"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      # effectifs DARES arrondis à 5 : taux masqué sous 100 hab. (erreur ±25 ‰)
      defm_pour_mille = ifelse(is.na(pop_latest) | pop_latest < 100,
                               NA_real_,
                               defm_abc / pop_latest * 1000)
    ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      code   = code_commune,
      pop    = pop_latest,
      strate = strate_pop,
      dens   = densite_insee,
      defm   = defm_abc,
      defmp  = round(defm_pour_mille, 1),
      g      = round(g, 2),
      p21    = p21
    )
  emit_table("demoData", demo_for_js)

  # Typologie de densité INSEE : niveaux ordonnés, rural -> urbain
  # (libellés lus dans la grille de densité : même source que CMap.densLabels)
  dens_levels <- unique(densite_data[order(densite_data$densite_rang), c("densite_rang", "densite_insee")])$densite_insee

  cat('<script>\n',
      'window.demoSeq = ', as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(PAL$green)), ';\n',
      'window.demoDensLevels = ', as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(dens_levels)), ';\n',
      'window.demoDensPalette = ', as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(PAL$dens)), ';\n',
      'window.demoDiv = ', as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(PAL$div)), ';\n',
      'window.demoFields = {\n',
      '  pop:   { key: "pop",   scale: "log_quantile", unit: "hab.", digits: 0, title: "Population (échelle log)" },\n',
      '  defmp: { key: "defmp", scale: "log_quantile", unit: "\u2030", digits: 1, title: "Demandeurs d\\u2019emploi, \u2030 de la population (échelle log)" },\n',
      '  g:     { key: "g", breaks: [-100, -1, -0.25, 0.25, 1, 100], digits: 2, unit: "%/an", title: "Croissance démographique annuelle, 2017 à 2021",\n',
      '           cats: ["baisse de plus de 1 %/an", "baisse de 0,25 à 1", "stable (±0,25)", "hausse de 0,25 à 1", "hausse de plus de 1 %/an"],\n',
      '           note: "Taux annuel moyen entre les recensements 2017 et 2021. Communes de moins de 200 habitants estompées : taux très instable." },\n',
      '  dens:  { key: "dens" }\n',
      '};\n',
      'window.demoRecolor = function(field) {\n',
      '  var f = window.demoFields[field];\n',
      '  var get = function (c) { var r = window.demoData[c]; return r ? r[f.key] : null; };\n',
      '  if (field === "dens") CMap.recolor({ get: get, levels: window.demoDensLevels, palette: window.demoDensPalette,\n',
      '    legend: { title: "Typologie de densité INSEE", naLabel: "Non classée" } });\n',
      '  else if (field === "g") CMap.recolor({ get: get, breaks: f.breaks, palette: window.demoDiv,\n',
      '    opacityOf: function (c) { var r = window.demoData[c]; return (r && r.p21 != null && r.p21 < 200) ? 0.35 : 0.9; },\n',
      '    legend: { title: f.title, unit: f.unit, digits: f.digits, cats: f.cats, note: f.note, naLabel: "Non calculable" } });\n',
      '  else CMap.recolor({ get: get, scale: f.scale, palette: window.demoSeq,\n',
      '    legend: { title: f.title, unit: f.unit, digits: f.digits, naLabel: "Non publié" } });\n',
      '};\n',
      'window.updateDemoPanel = function(code) {\n',
      '  var el = document.getElementById("demo-content");\n',
      '  if (!el) return;\n',
      '  var d = window.demoData[code];\n',
      '  var elec = window.communeLookup && window.communeLookup[code];\n',
      '  var alt  = window.communeNames && window.communeNames[code];\n',
      '  var nom  = elec ? elec.nom_commune : (alt ? alt.nom : code);\n',
      '  var dept = elec ? (elec.libelle_dept + " (" + elec.code_dept + ")") : (alt ? ("Dépt " + alt.dept) : "");\n',
      '  if (!d) {\n',
      '    el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \'</div></div><div class="dvf-empty">Pas de données démographiques publiées.</div>\';\n',
      '    return;\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  function fmtInt(x) { return (x == null) ? "—" : Number(x).toLocaleString("fr-FR"); }\n',
      '  function fmtP(x) { if (x == null) return "—"; return Number(x).toFixed(1); }\n',
      '  el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \'</div></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section"><h4>Population (INSEE)</h4>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kvs">\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Habitants</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmtInt(d.pop) + \'</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Strate</span><span class="cp-num">\' + (d.strate || "—") + \'</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'</div></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section"><h4>Typologie spatiale</h4>\' +\n',
      '    \'<p class="cp-def">Classification INSEE en <strong>6 niveaux</strong> du rural pur au grand centre urbain. Basée sur la densité de population et le maillage du bâti.</p>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kvs">\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Grille densité</span><span class="cp-num">\' + (d.dens || "—") + \'</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'</div></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section"><h4>Demandeurs d\u2019emploi (DEFM cat. A,B,C)</h4>\' +\n',
      '    \'<p class="cp-def"><strong>DEFM</strong> = Demandeurs d\\\'Emploi en Fin de Mois (DARES). Cat. A (sans activité) + B (activité réduite courte) + C (activité réduite longue). Différent du <em>taux de chômage INSEE</em> (méthodo BIT, par enquête).</p>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kvs">\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Demandeurs</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmtInt(d.defm) + \'</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Taux ‰</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmtP(d.defmp) + \' ‰</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'</div></div>\';\n',
      '};\n',
      '</script>\n',
      sep = ""
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: map-demo
if (demo_ready) {
  vals0 <- pop_data |> dplyr::transmute(code_commune, value = pop_latest)
  st_demo <- cmap_breaks(vals0$value[vals0$code_commune %in% com_metro_only$code], "log_quantile")
  m <- cmap_choropleth(com_metro_only, dep_metro, vals0, palette = PAL$green,
                       legend_title = "Population (échelle log)", unit = "hab.", digits = 0L,
                       scale = "log_quantile", breaks = st_demo, na_label = "Non publié")
  cmap_on_render(m, cmap_page_hooks(
    "demo", "updateDemoPanel", "demo-content", "demo-ind", "demoRecolor", "pop",
    ctx = list(ctx_spec("ctx_log_pop", "Population", "hab.", 0L, log10 = TRUE),
               ctx_spec("defm_taux_pop", "Demandeurs d'emploi", "‰", 1L))))
} else {
  htmltools::HTML("<p class='js-loading'>Données démographiques non chargées.</p>")
}
```
:::
